text:
Maya L.: quick sync - we keep getting asked by SIs about who owns a marketplace listing vs who owns co-sell pipeline. need a simple rule set.

Omar V.: yep. complaint from HW partner yesterday: two integrators listed joint solutions, both doing outreach to same account. customers annoyed.

Priya S.: high level proposal: marketplace listing owner = whoever submitted the validated solution artifact. co-sell pipeline owner = whoever logged the first qualified lead in SFDC for that account-product pair. allow a 72h joint-window where both can engage before ownership locks.

Tom B.: 72h seems long for high-velocity deals. can we do 48h for outbound cadences, but keep a 72h window for legal/commercial negotiations?

Maya L.: ok compromise: 48h outreach freeze for new cadences (to avoid conflicting emails), 72h arbitration window for deal-level ownership. after 72h system picks primary owner based on last-touch priority.

Priya S.: from ops perspective we need two controls in SFDC and automation: (1) a "marketplace_flag" on products, (2) a "co_own_window" timestamp on account-product. automation checks both before creating cadence.

Omar V.: sketch of rule for automation: 
```
if co_own_window.exists and now < co_own_window + 48h:
  block_new_cadence()
elif arbitration_requested:
  create_partnership_ticket(account, product, participants=[si_a, si_b])
else:
  allow_cadence()
```

Tom B.: also add metadata attachments to ticket: listing_submission_id, initial_lead_record, last_2_calls. helps quick decision.

Maya L.: agree. and requirement for joint-announcement: both SIs must sign announcement checklist (comms owner, approved messaging, co-branding). ops should hold listing publish until checklist cleared.

Priya S.: can we make checklist a small doc in the marketplace listing flow? checkbox fields that block publish. reduces manual gating.

ops-bot: created PART-MP-221: "Co-ownership window + marketplace publish gating" assigned to @Tom B.

Omar V.: pilot idea: run in APAC market first where partner density is lower, helps iterate fast.

Tom B.: will scope engineering tasks: webhook guard (1 day), ticket enrichment (2 days), checklist UI (3 days). aiming for a 2-week sprint.

Maya L.: great. please drop RFC link and PRD in this thread when ready. reactions = :white_check_mark: if you approve the 48h outreach freeze + 72h arbitration window.

Priya S.: :white_check_mark:

Omar V.: :white_check_mark:

Tom B.: :white_check_mark: I'll add notes to the partner playbook.

(End of thread)
